status: frozen before executing the analytic flux-geometry and SPARC boundary-inversion diagnostics
research_question: Can low-density space alter gravitational flux geometry so a flattened galaxy receives an extended inward field without an additive negative-mass force, while spherical clusters receive a same-metric enhancement?

known_benchmark.name: Refracted Gravity
known_benchmark.equation: div[epsilon(rho) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho
known_benchmark.originality_rule: Density-dependent gravitational permittivity, its disk-refraction mechanism, and its covariant scalar-tensor completion are established prior art and must never be presented as inventions of this project.

project_variant.name: Nonlocal Basin Permittivity zero-order candidate (NBP0)
weak_field_equations: div[epsilon(X) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b
project_variant.distinction_under_test: epsilon is controlled by a reciprocal nonlocal basin field X and cosmological boundary solution, not assigned algebraically from the local density or fitted by object class.
project_variant.reciprocity_rule: The epsilon'(X)|grad Phi|^2 backreaction from varying the same action is mandatory and cannot be dropped after choosing epsilon(X).
project_variant.relativistic_rule: A later covariant action must derive both metric potentials and lensing; the Newtonian constitutive equation alone makes no cluster-lensing prediction.

analytic_limits.spherical: For constant epsilon outside a spherical source, g=GM/(epsilon r^2); permittivity changes amplitude but cannot flatten the curve.
analytic_limits.perfectly_confined_slab: If flux is confined between planes separated by 2h, g=GM/(epsilon_in h r) and v_flat^2=GM/(epsilon_in h).
analytic_limits.mass_scaling_requirement: With universal epsilon_in, v_flat^4 proportional to M_b requires h proportional to sqrt(M_b). The boundary height must be predicted from non-kinematic structure or basin data, not inferred from V_flat.

SPARC_boundary_inversion.blindness_rule: V_flat and its uncertainty define the inverted h_required target only. They are forbidden from every boundary predictor.

confounding_control_amendment.reason: The initial geometry gate passed, exposing an identity-level confound: h_required=GM/V_flat^2 can be predicted from mass whenever the BTFR holds. A boundary interpretation therefore requires non-kinematic structure to outperform a mass-only BTFR control. No original threshold or result was changed.

cluster_control.calculation: At each cluster's outermost summary point, invert epsilon_required=gbar/gtot and report cross-system scatter without treating the GR/NFW-derived table as a theory-neutral likelihood.

stop_rules: A successful slab inversion does not establish the reciprocal field or lensing action.
If non-kinematic structure cannot predict h_required, reject perfect flux confinement as an explanation rather than fitting h per galaxy.
If CF4 void information fails its frozen improvement and permutation gates, do not call the mechanism void-specific.
Do not fit epsilon(X) until its reciprocal backreaction and relativistic metric are derived and the same-system data gate passes.
